headline: Sensex Slips While Nifty Gains; Smallcaps Jump Amid Fed Policy Anticipation
why: Anticipation of the upcoming US Federal Reserve interest rate decision
Strong performance in metal and FMCG sectors boosting Nifty indices
Massive investor interest in the Jindal Supreme IPO subscription
Profit booking in major IT stocks dragging the Sensex performance
whatHappening: Sensex ended 22 points lower while Nifty gained 53-75 points
Smallcap stocks outperformed the broader market with a 1.8% jump
iPhone 18 Pro day one sales surged 15-28% over previous models
SBI projects ₹5 trillion notional profit for banks from FCNR(B) deposits
summary: The Indian markets showed mixed results as the Nifty managed gains while the Sensex closed slightly in the red. Smallcap and metal stocks led the rally, contrasting with a drag in the IT sector ahead of the US Fed meeting. High demand for the Jindal Supreme IPO and strong iPhone 18 sales provided additional market optimism.
